recent_posts.text:
Brand authenticity is the trust bridge in AI posting
This model from a 2024 study in the
Journal of Retailing and Consumer Services
is pretty direct: generative AI adoption affects follower reactions partly through brand authenticity.
• No adoption, assistance, and automation are treated as three different setups
• The outcomes are post credibility, brand attitudes, EWOM intentions, and brand loyalty
• The dashed path is the direct AI effect; the other path runs through brand authenticity
AI is not automatically the problem. Automation is where the trust penalty gets sharper, while assistance is the safer middle ground.
That maps cleanly to founder personas on X – keep the founder voice human, and let AI help with research, clustering, and drafting, not replace judgment.
Data source:
Journal of Retailing and Consumer Services
Related read:
How to Grow a Founder Persona on X: A Practical Founder Growth System

Institutional share of crypto spot volume hits record 72%, reshaping market structure –
Link
Wintermute OTC data shows institutions accounted for 72% of spot trading volume in H1 2026, up from 59% a year earlier. Altcoin options volume also rose about 3.4x versus H2 2025, while realized volatility fell to around 45% from roughly 70% in prior cycles.
Matters because: crypto price action is becoming more institutional and derivatives-driven, which may make the market less retail-led and more sensitive to OTC/options positioning.
